answer: The ferrous is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the juniper. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. Reaching the ember of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
